text:
Predicates:
MusicPiece(x) ::: x is a music piece.
Composer(x) ::: x is a composer.
Write(x, y) ::: x writes y.
Premiere(x, y) ::: x premieres y.
Orchestra(x) ::: x is an orchestra.
Lead(x, y) ::: x leads y.
Conductor(x) ::: x is a conductor.

Premises:
MusicPiece(symphony9) ::: Symphony No. 9 is a music piece.
∀x ∀y (Composer(x) ∧ MusicPiece(y) → Write(x, y)) ::: Composers write music pieces.
Write(beethoven, symphony9) ::: Beethoven wrote Symphony No. 9.
Premiere(viennaMusicSociety, symphony9) ::: Vienna Music Society premiered Symphony No. 9.
Orchestra(viennaMusicSociety) ::: Vienna Music Society is an orchestra.
Lead(beethoven, viennaMusicSociety) ::: Beethoven leads the Vienna Music Society.
∀x ∀y (Orchestra(x) ∧ Lead(y, x) → Conductor(y)) ::: Orchestras are led by conductors.

Conclusion:
¬Conductor(beethoven) ::: Beethoven is not a conductor.
